title: A walk through the work.
subtitle: A small gallery of products I've designed, engineered, and shipped — each one solving a real problem for real users.

items.name: AI Resume Builder
items.shortDesc: An AI co-pilot that turns three sentences into a recruiter-ready resume in minutes.
items.longDesc: A React + Firebase application powered by the OpenAI API. It handles multi-step form flows, real-time preview, beautiful template switching, persistent user sessions, and one-click PDF export. The entire experience is keyboard-friendly, fully responsive, and ships with autosave so users never lose a draft.

items.name: Never Know
items.shortDesc: A full-stack PERN marketplace with role-based dashboards, JWT auth, and a real cart.
items.longDesc: Every part of this build was hand-rolled: relational schema design, JWT authentication, protected routes, dynamic listings, cart and transaction tracking, and admin tooling. Express middleware does the gatekeeping while PostgreSQL keeps the data honest.

items.name: Recipe Bloggers
items.shortDesc: A community where home chefs publish recipes, drop reactions, and trade kitchen wisdom.
items.longDesc: A MERN stack platform with token-based authentication, modular Express routes, and Mongoose-validated schemas. Users can post recipes, like, comment, manage their profile, and follow chefs. Built to feel snappy on slow networks.

items.name: Notes
items.shortDesc: A MERN notes app with categories, tags, and a UI quick enough to keep up with thought.
items.longDesc: A minimal but production-grade notes app. Full CRUD, JWT auth, protected routes, MongoDB indexing for fast tag queries, and a Tailwind UI built around React hooks. Designed to feel friendlier than a sticky note and quicker than a doc.

items.name: Report Analysis Suite
items.shortDesc: An admin-grade analytics tool that turns sprawling business reports into one-glance insights.
items.longDesc: A full-stack analytics dashboard built at YPSS. It ingests business reports, runs aggregations, and ships clean visualisations — bar, line, area, and donut charts — to operations teams. Behind the curtain: efficient SQL, server-side caching, and a careful UI that respects power users.

items.name: Social Platform
items.shortDesc: A social network prototype with feeds, friends, real-time chat, and a clean moderation layer.
items.longDesc: An ambitious YPSS project: posts, follower graphs, real-time messaging, content moderation, and an admin panel for trust & safety. Built to test how lean a team can ship a social product without losing the basics.
